x: Young Wade, too, is beginning to make a name for himself, particularly in the jumps, and with Paddy Fyman,shot, Tony Moritz, discus 137 feet, and Chris Page,javelin, it appears that this side of athletics is being well taken care of.

Derek's reply was to up his best yet again, as he placed 2nd with 7.30 behind Earle (BRC) 7.39 and ahead of Wade (AAA) 7.16. John Bicourt made a guest appearance in the 2,000 'chase, timed at 5:49.0 for 5th.

Big headwinds made sprinting difficult and with strong fields and five false starts Darren Chin struggled in the A 100 but the situation was immediately recovered when Wade Bennett Jackson won the B race.

Nonetheless Wade Bennett-Jackson powered to a fine second spot in the A 100 and fourth place in the A 200. William Sharman completed his fourth win of the season in the sprint hurdles and gained third spot in the B 200.
